The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the memorandum of grounds filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of Sri D. Kasi Rao, Advocate for the Petitioner and of the Public Prosecutor on behalf of respondent/State, the Court made the following ORDER :

- 
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NO.3945 OF 2020 ORDER:
.

This petition is filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C to enlarge the petitioner/A.1 on bail in Cr.No.532/2020 on the file of Nallapadu Police Station, Guntur District for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 188, 353, 336, 273,328,420 of Indian Penal Code (for short '1.P.C') and Sections 58, 59, 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 ffor short FSS Act') and Section 8(c) and 20 of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1958 (for short 'NDPS Act'.

entities.text: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1958
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner/A.1 was arrested on 27.05.2020 and produced before the learned Special Mobile Magistrate Court, Guntur and remanded to judicial custody.

2. The case of prosecution in brief, is that on 27.05.2020, the petitioner/A.1 along with A.2 and A.3 was found illegally transporting Tobacco Products like Gutkha, Khaine etc., and 5 Kgs of 'Ganja' in TATA Safari Car bearing No.AP 07 BN 8586 and at that time, they were apprehended by the police and the contraband was seized from their possession.

Therefore, the petitioner/A.1 has committed the aforesaid offences.
3.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for State.

4. The contraband involved in this case is 5 Kgs, which is not a commercial quantity and therefore,
the petitioner/A.1 is entitled to be enlarged on bail as he is in judicial custody since 27.05.2020.

Hence, taking into consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case, including languishing of petitioner in jail since 27.05.2020, the petitioner/A.1 can be enlarged on bail, as Section 37 of NDPS Act has no application to the present facts of the case.

5S. In the result, Criminal Petition is allowed granting bail to the petitioner/A.1 on executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousands only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of Special Mobile Magistrate,
Guntur.
